entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your order number now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I see you've entered your order number for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. How can I help you today?
I need to return it. Just send me a label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm routing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. It's not for me. Look, I don't have time for a long call. I tried to do this weeks ago, on day nine, but there was a website error.
A website error, I see. I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the site.
Yes, the whole system was down. I got an error page and couldn't print the label. I even have a screenshot. Are you going to process this or not?
My apologies for that inconvenience. I'm pulling up your purchase date now... and let me just check the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, yes. I see you received it 41 days ago. That's no problem at all, you're well within our 90-day return window. I've just processed the return for you.

It's already on its way to your email. You should see it in the next minute or two. And since you're a VIP member and had to deal with that system down message, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase. We do apologize for that website error.
Fine. Thank you. That's all I needed.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
